questions.solution: ${8} over {7}$$rm {bar{AD}} = it 7a$, $rm {bar{BD}} = it 5a$, $rm {bar{AE}} = it 4b$, $rm {bar{CE}} = it b$라 하면, $S= rm TRIANGLE ADE=` it {1} over {2} TIMES 7a TIMES 4b TIMES sinA=14sinA$$T= rm TRIANGLE ADE- TRIANGLE ADE=` it {1} over {2} TIMES 12a TIMES 5b TIMES sinA- {1} over {2} TIMES 7a TIMES 4b TIMES sinA$$=30ab`sinA-14`ab`sinA=16ab`sinA$${T} over {S} = {16ab`sinA} over {14ab`sinA} = {8} over {7}$
